weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: Composite of same-block cUSD vault sleeve weights and the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund SEC Form N-MFP3 average portfolio maturity. At finalized Ethereum block 25627164 (hash 0xd3fb5dc51425ba009cf716f59e4923bdcf0f4d1abc6dfa8481c45409fbdf96b5, 2026-07-27T22:33:59Z) via ethereum.publicnode.com, cUSD totalSupplies returned 67,989,695.834991 USDC and 5,098,067.908917473 WTGXX (93.0247% / 6.9753% of the 73,087,763.743908 sleeve; 99.9986% of same-block cUSD totalSupply 73,088,778.525048). USDC treated as 0-day demand claim; WTGXX multiplied by the fund's reportDate 2026-06-30 averagePortfolioMaturity of 43 days → WAM 2.999366. stcUSD is an ERC-4626 claim on that cUSD portfolio (asset() = cUSD; totalSupply 62,255,932.853420 shares; totalAssets 66,778,737.971204 cUSD; rate 1.072649).

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: 0 denotes continuous on-chain oracle-valued vault accounting and ERC-4626 share-price accrual, not a manager marking cycle. Cap Vault docs: mint/burn at oracle value with staleness disable; stcUSD convertToAssets/totalAssets readable every block.

legalEnforceability.basis: Primary Cap Risks documentation (re-opened 2026-07-28) states Cap operates without reliance on third-party custodians, regulatory frameworks, or manual oversight, and that cUSD holder protections are enforced exclusively by code-based adherence to protocol rules. stcUSD is the ERC-4626 staked wrapper of that same cUSD claim (on-chain asset() pin), so holder recovery against the reserve and operator-lending book is smart-contract execution only. Independent legal corroboration from Covered Agents S.A. Platform Terms of Use (Panama corporation; last revised 2025-03-26; re-opened 2026-07-28): the Company is the website/front-end operator of a 'fully decentralized lending protocol' designed for direct user access without Company involvement; users release Company from platform-related claims; financial-loss liability is disclaimed to the maximum extent permitted; user's sole remedy for dissatisfaction is to cease use; governing law and arbitration are Panama/CeCAP. Cap Financial Guarantees docs further confine off-chain legal agreements to Underwriter–Borrower Guarantor Agreements after liquidation, not to a published holder claim, trust deed, bankruptcy-remote SPV, perfected security interest, or regulatory-register redemption right for stcUSD/cUSD holders. Weak is graded because the deficiency is affirmatively documented by the issuer and its legal terms, not because evidence is merely absent (D3). No prospectus, fund-share register, or court-enforceable holder estate was found.
